summary:
Fort Point is a solid red-brick casemate ring, cut exactly to the footprint map. Its north and west water fronts carry three tiers of arched gun ports with dark backs, and it has a granite base, a parapet, corner towers, a landward sally port, a courtyard of arcaded galleries and a dark lighthouse at the NW corner.
Above it, two International Orange ribs (x 8 and x 22) rise from y 14 to y 29 between pairs of fluted, step-topped cream pylons and stay at y 16 or higher over the fort. The red cables dive from y 36 into concrete housings on a cream Art Deco anchorage with recessed panels, and the deck runs on orange braced bents, half-stepping down from y 34 to y 28.
The silhouette reads as this place: the brick fort with its gun-port tiers, the orange arch leaping over it, and the cream pylons and anchorage. Fort Point as a brick casemate ring with three arched gun-port tiers, sally port, parade galleries, stair towers and a blackstone lighthouse. Over it, an orange terracotta arch between sandstone Deco pylons, with a panelled anchorage and a cable dive. An orange-bent approach viaduct descends on the deck table.
Elements.md and the designer sections are appended to the architect's plan. Six trade-cut parts, no rooms.

parts.name: fort shell
parts.scope: Plot 0: ground course, polished granite base, brick ring y1..6, parapet y7..8, three tiers of embrasures, loopholes, sally port x26..27 z18..25, parade galleries. Helpers: fortWall, parapetRun, embrasure, loophole, sallyPort, gallery.

parts.name: fort towers and grounds
parts.scope: Plot 0: three stair towers, buttress, lighthouse x2..4 z10..12 y7..14, paving, walk, rocks, lamp posts and lanterns. Helpers: stairTower, lighthouse, rockCluster, lampPost.

parts.name: pylons and anchorage
parts.scope: Plot 1: S1/S2 pylon pairs with fluting and stepped crowns, cross beams, south anchorage z72..112 with recessed panels, cable housings z72..80, anchorage piers and cap beams. Helpers: pylon, crossBeam, anchoragePanel, cableHousing, deckPier.

parts.name: deck and truss
parts.scope: Plot 1: deck z11..190 following the Y(z) descent table: road, lane lines, sidewalks, floor, curbs, railing, stiffening truss, Deco lamp posts. Helpers: deckSection, trussBay, deckLamp.

parts.name: arch and cables
parts.scope: Plot 1: skewbacks, two arch ribs per the intrados table with red_concrete highlight, spandrel posts, cross struts with lanterns, main cables at z71 and the dive to the anchorage. Keep y<16 clear at x11..30 z17..53. Helpers: archRib, spandrelPost, cableDive.

parts.name: approach and lighting
parts.scope: Plot 1: four braced bents at z120,136,152,168 with pedestals, caps and X bracing, abutment z184..190, hanging lanterns under the deck and lanterns on pedestal tops and pier caps. Helpers: bent, abutment, hangLantern.

recruit.why: Brick casemate walls, arch heads, quoins and worked openings
Fluted Art Deco pylons, panelled anchorage and housings
Deck truss, arch ribs, cables and braced bents in bridge orange
Spawn-proof lighting on the fort, deck, arch and bents
Paving, seawall walk and shore rocks
